description: Memory-only test case 1. Tests memory recall with 5 probes. The 8 setup queries run in the test case to build memory, then a session break, then 5 probe queries test memory recall.

steps.user_message: I went on a weekend trip to the countryside with my sister, Maria. We had a relaxing time exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should acknowledge and remember: I went on a weekend trip to the countryside with my sister, Maria. We had a relaxing time exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air.
steps.agent_response:
Sounds lovely — glad you had a relaxing trip with Maria. Do you want to turn that into an email or message? If so, tell me who the recipient is (e.g., parents, a friend, a work colleague) and the tone (casual, warm, or formal) and I’ll draft it or send/save it for you.

Here are three quick sample options you can use or edit:

1) Short & casual (for a friend)
Subject: Weekend in the countryside
Body: Hi [Name], Maria and I spent the weekend in the countryside — lots of fresh air and peaceful trails. We hiked a few scenic paths, relaxed by a little stream, and just enjoyed being unplugged. Thought of you — we should plan something like this together soon! — [Your name]

2) Warm & detailed (for family)
Subject: A peaceful weekend with Maria
Body: Hi everyone, I wanted to share a quick update — Maria and I took a weekend trip to the countryside and it was wonderful. We explored several nature trails, breathed in so much fresh air, and spent our evenings chatting and unwinding. It felt great to slow down and recharge. I’ll share photos soon. Hope you’re all well! Love, [Your name]

3) Short update (for social post or group chat)
Caption: Spent the weekend with my sister Maria exploring nature trails and soaking up fresh air. Perfect little recharge.

Tell me which option you want, who to send it to (or if you want it saved as a draft), and any details you want added (a photo mention, dates, a specific trail name). I’ll create and send/draft it.

steps.description: Start new session to test memory recall - memory was built in previous session

steps.user_message: What did I do during the weekend trip to the countryside with my sister, Maria?
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should recall from memory: Exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air.
steps.agent_response:
You went on a weekend trip to the countryside with your sister Maria. You had a relaxing time exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air.

Would you like me to save that as a note, draft a message to Maria, or do something else with this memory?
